rules.statement: In the absence of a precise description of metes and bounds, a conveyance is interpreted as conveying only an undivided share in the larger land.
rules.supporting_quote: "where the words of description contained in the grant are sufficiently clear with reference to extent, locality and ether relevant matters to permit of an exact demarcation of all the boundaries of what has been conveyed, then the grant is of a defined allotment. If, however, the language is insufficient to permit of such a demarcation, the grant must be interpreted as conveying only an undivided share in the larger land."
